summary: Software Architect alternate pose source image for the Issue #56 stakeholder pack. The image shows a full-body isolated Software Architect figure on a plain white background, in a relaxed standing or three-quarter view that varies from the hero pose through a different hand gesture or prop arrangement. He is a calm, approachable adult man with dark curly hair and a grey side streak, a neatly trimmed beard, black rectangular glasses, an olive-brown blazer over a cream or white shirt, dark navy trousers, and brown casual shoes. A blue lanyard badge with a hexagonal system icon is visible, and he carries architecture props such as a tablet showing a system diagram, a central module cube, cloud and database icons, dependency arrows, and a rolled blueprint held under one arm. The rendering is the clean vector-adjacent Adventures editorial style with soft painterly shading, warm light, and a technically grounded, helpful expression.
